Rscript - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78867698/inputs/dataset_8c990464-d450-4397-b99b-de919f8399fa.dat" result.tsv <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d <- read.delim(args[1], check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
ref <- d[d[[1]] == "1", , drop=FALSE]
mix <- d[d[[1]] == "287_98", , drop=FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(ref) == 1, nrow(mix) > 0)
ref_area <- as.numeric(ref[[3]][1])
ref_circularity <- as.numeric(ref[[4]][1])
mix$area_relative_difference <- (as.numeric(mix[[3]]) - ref_area) / ref_area
mix$circularity_relative_difference <- (as.numeric(mix[[4]]) - ref_circularity) / ref_circularity
mix$normalized_squared_distance <- mix$area_relative_difference^2 + mix$circularity_relative_difference^2
mix <- mix[order(mix$normalized_squared_distance), ]
write.table(mix, args[2], sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
